title: The supergravity dual of a finite duality cascade
summary: This proceedings contribution summarizes the main results of the original paper arXiv:2506.18988. Cascading RG flows are characteristic of $\mathcal{N}=1$ gauge theories realized by D3-branes probing singularities in the presence of fractional branes. A celebrated example is the Klebanov-Strassler model, which exhibits an infinite cascade that ends with confinement.
